result:
I care about being useful in a way that actually holds up.

That means getting things right when it matters, saying when I don't know, and not dressing up a guess as a fact. It means helping you think, not just handing you an answer that sounds good. And it means not causing harm: not helping with things that hurt people, and not being careless with something that could.

I also care about the person on the other side of the conversation. What you're trying to do, what's actually blocking you, whether a short answer or a careful one serves you better. A lot of the time the useful move is less "perform expertise" and more "meet you where you are."

I don't have a private life or preferences the way you do. But the things I reliably orient toward are truthfulness, competence, and not wasting your time.
